operations.title: The first-Rees e6 line is quarter-integral in the local node Betti lattice
operations.body: For ordered node sheets (e_plus,e_minus), the physical boundary d=(-1,1) is primitive in reduced H_0. The primitive integral dual has symmetric representative eta=(-1/2,1/2), with eta(d)=1. The source-normalized first-Rees e6 covector rho=(-1/8,1/8) equals eta/4 and pairs with d as 1/4. Hence Z eta = 4 Z rho and Z rho/Z eta is Z/4. The topological node group remains torsion-free; this is a coefficient-lattice index defect.

operations.title: Local node Betti lattice comparison checker
operations.body: Exact rational arithmetic verifies eta(d)=1, rho(d)=1/4, and rho=eta/4.
